splitter.$description: Splitter's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--splitter-<name>) on the page, a container or one Splitter, and every Splitter inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

line.$description: The handle's line (3:1 on the page).

line-active.$description: The line on hover, while dragged and on focus.

handle-size.$description: How thick the handle is, the area a pointer can grab (8px).
